title: 第二十三章　变异
content_zh:
变了的，就是异类吗？还是不同的，就是异类？

    住在基地A区的艾妮尔他们各有事做，比如，艾妮尔只顾躺着睡觉，或者说不动，艾勒维格他们忙着找F区的入口，萨尔则一直保持着沉默，坐在艾妮尔的房中，看着床上的她，回想着前些天的那次冲突，虽然没有打起来，可是面对如此的艾妮尔，已经足够让他束手无策。

    艾勒维格他们将通向B区的通道走了个遍，可是一圈下来，最后他们还是回到了A区，而不是C区，由于那次的游戏，B区中参与游戏的贵族们已经对他们熟悉不过，所以他们的出现，又消失，对于他们来说，完全可以做到视而不见。

    在无次数的出现又消失之后，B区的负责人终于忍不住了，“喂！”

    “你是叫我们？”多力走在最后，而艾勒维格他们已经走出了酒馆。

    “不错，我就是叫你们呢！”负责人说着指了指多力。

    “你叫我们什么事？”多力回身看着对方，不过他转身之际，还不忘了叫住前面的艾勒维格他们，“艾勒维格，你们等等！负责人有话说！”

    结果，最后就是一桌上，他们四位对着B区负责人。

    “我知道我们不同，因为我是人类，你是贵族！”艾勒维格阴笑着，其实他早就在考虑着如何用最直接也是最方便的方法找到F区的入口。

    “哈哈！”B区负责人大笑道，“原来人类这么有意思，难怪首领一直想着生活到人类中去！”

    “可能吗？”多力虽然胆子不大，可是就是嘴快，想到什么说什么，话一出口才知道堵嘴，但是那时已经晚了。

    “说实话，我也觉得不可能！”结果对方不但不生气，而且还一脸笑意的赞同道。

    “那为什么还……”多力还要深入了解，结果被艾勒维格的一个眼神给堵住了，“我想负责人你叫住我们，应该有什么想说的吧？”

    “你们在找C区的入口？”对方倒也不绕圈子。

    “C区？”尼克冷冷一笑，“如果可以的话，我们想去F区！”

    “什么？F区？”负责人还没表现出什么，旁桌已经有人跳了起来，“你们以为自己是谁啊？去F区？哈哈~太可笑了，以你们的实力想去F区，简直就是天大的笑话。”

    “我听说，好像没有规定什么样的实力才能去F区吧？”艾勒维格比较平静，笑着，只是有点阴冷，说着，只是有点异味。

    “这倒是，不过在Ｆ区如果没有足够的实力，活着比消失更痛苦。”负责人和气的笑了笑，“当然，如果你们想去，对方又愿意接受你们，那么自然不会有什么问题。”

    “那入口呢？”艾勒维格比起以往，问的更加直接，不是因为走累了，找烦了，而是感觉到对方似乎愿意告诉他，所以就顺水推舟了。

    “你们也知道，从Ａ区到Ｃ区在地面上，而Ｄ区到Ｆ区在地下。”负责人却如艾勒维格所想的一般，没有再绕什么弯子。

    “不错，这个我们早就知道。”多力点了点头，有点泄气道，“可是我们顺着这个通道走了无数遍，还是只能来到Ｂ区，别说是Ｆ区了，连Ｃ区都没有找到。”

    “呵呵！这是因为你们并不知道这个基地的建筑布局。”说着，负责人用指尖沾了杯中的酒在桌面上画了两个圆，一个顺走，一个逆行，“地面上的三个区都是以顺时钟的前行，进入Ｂ区之后，你们继续以顺时钟的方向向前，才能走到Ｃ区，而不是像你们那样以逆时钟的方向回去。”

    “你是说……”艾勒维格他们三人皆转头望向酒馆吧台，吧台的后面是一面放着酒架的墙，可是墙后面呢？没有人知道。

    “不错！”负责人点了点头，“那里通向C区。”

    “那F区呢？”多力傻呼呼的问。

    “笨！”尼克瞪了他一眼，“自然就在Ｃ区的下一站了！”

    “原来是这样！”多力这才恍然大悟的点起了头。

    “那就谢了！”艾勒维格说着站起身来，尼克和埃布尔会意的离了座，除了多力还愣在那里不动，“多力！走了！”

    “喂！”眼看艾勒维格他们就要走进Ａ区的通道，负责人急忙叫道。
content_en:
Are those who have changed become aliens? Or is it different, alien?

    Enel and the others who lived in Area A of the base had their own things to do. For example, Enel just lay down and slept, or said nothing, Ellevig and the others were busy looking for the entrance to Area F. Sal remained silent, sitting in Enel's room, looking at her on the bed, thinking about the conflict a few days ago. Although there was no fight, facing Enel like this was enough to make him helpless.

    Ellevig and the others walked all the passages leading to Area B, but after a circle, they finally returned to Area A instead of Area C. Due to that game, the nobles participating in the game in Area B were already familiar with them, so their appearance and disappearance could be completely ignored for them.

    After appearing and disappearing countless times, the person in charge of Area B finally couldn't help it anymore, "Hey!"

    "Are you calling us?" Doli walked at the end, while Ellevig and the others had already walked out of the tavern.

    "That's right, I'm just calling you!" the person in charge said, pointing at Duoli.

    "What did you call us for?" Duoli turned around and looked at the other party, but when he turned around, he didn't forget to call out to Ellevig and the others in front of him, "Ellevig, wait! The person in charge has something to say!"

    As a result, there was a table at the end, with the four of them facing the person in charge of Area B.

    "I know we are different, because I am a human and you are a noble!" Ellevig smiled sinisterly. In fact, he had already been thinking about how to find the entrance to Area F in the most direct and convenient way.

    "Haha!" the person in charge of Area B laughed, "Humans are so interesting, no wonder the leader has always wanted to live among humans!"

    "Is it possible?" Although Duoli was not very courageous, he was quick to talk and said whatever came to his mind. He didn't know how to gag until the words came out, but by then it was already too late.

    "To be honest, I don't think it's possible!" As a result, the other party not only wasn't angry, but also agreed with a smile on his face.

    "Then why..." Doli wanted to go deeper, but was blocked by Ellevig's look, "I think you, the person in charge, stopped us. You should have something to say, right?"

    "Are you looking for the entrance to Area C?" The other party didn't go around in circles.

    "Area C?" Nick smiled coldly, "If possible, we want to go to Area F!"

    "What? Area F?" Before the person in charge could say anything, someone at the table next to him had already jumped up. "Who do you think you are? Going to Area F? Haha~ It's so ridiculous. With your ability, wanting to go to Area F is just a big joke."

    "I heard that there seems to be no stipulation on what kind of strength can be used to go to Area F, right?" Ellevig was relatively calm, smiling, but a little cold, and said that there was just a bit of an odor.

    "That's true, but if you don't have enough strength in Area F, it will be more painful to live than to disappear." The person in charge smiled angrily, "Of course, if you want to go and the other party is willing to accept you, then there will be no problem."

    "What about the entrance?" Ellevig asked more directly than before, not because he was tired of walking or tired of searching, but because he felt that the other party seemed willing to tell him, so he went along with the flow.

    "You also know that Area A to Area C are on the ground, while Area D to Area F are underground." The person in charge did not make any more detours, just as Ellerweg thought.

    "Yes, we have known this for a long time." Duoli nodded and said a little discouraged, "But we have walked along this passage countless times, and we can still only come to Area B, not to mention Area F, and we haven't even found Area C."

    "Haha! This is because you don't know the architectural layout of this base." As he spoke, the person in charge dipped his fingertips into the glass of wine and drew two circles on the table, one going forward and one going backwards. "The three areas on the ground all move forward in a clockwise direction. After entering Area B, you continue to move forward in a clockwise direction to reach Area C, instead of going back in a counterclockwise direction like you did."

    "You mean..." All three of them turned to look at the bar. Behind the bar was a wall with a wine rack, but what about behind the wall? No one knows.

    "Not bad!" The person in charge nodded, "That leads to Area C."

    "What about Area F?" Duoli asked stupidly.

    "Stupid!" Nick glared at him, "Of course it's the next stop in Area C!"

    "So that's it!" Duoli nodded in realization.

    "Thanks!" Ellevig said and stood up. Nick and Abel left their seats knowingly. Except for Doli, he still stayed there. "Doli! Let's go!"

    "Hey!" Seeing that Ellevig and the others were about to enter the passage in Area A, the person in charge hurriedly called out.
